notes.subject: dorokelen ka taa dorokelen ma
notes.rationale: לדר ודר 'generation and generation' — Bamanankan keeps the movement-image 'goes to generation'

notes.subject: sagaw
notes.rationale: צאן is a collective for sheep and goats; Bamanankan has no single word, saga (sheep) chosen

notes.subject: an bɛ
notes.rationale: Hebrew participles נודה/נספר carry the subject 'we'; Bamanankan pronoun made explicit

notes.subject: to Yawe
notes.rationale: the congregation answers God directly, vowing endless praise

translation: Anw, aw ka jama ani aw ka sagaw minnu bɛ aw ka marali kɔnɔ, an bɛ aw duwali ju bɛɛ, dorokelen ka taa dorokelen ma; an bɛ aw ka ɲɛfɔli jate.
